synopsis: Dark-fantasy realism 8k cinematic gladiator trailer. A floating aerial camera approaches and dives into the Stage 1 Common Colosseum as the stadium crowd roars, spotlighting the three Newblood Stable starter creatures—the Common Dragon, Common Stegosaurus, and Common Dire Wolf—uniting in the center stone battle ring.

assetCards.name: set_colosseum_common
assetCards.prompt: 8k dark-fantasy realism, wide low-angle symmetrical view across the Stage 1 Common Colosseum at night under dark storm clouds. A circular cracked flagstone battle ring in the foreground leads to wide stone steps and a central arched timber-and-iron portcullis beast-gate, flanked by two unpolished stone warrior statues and tattered earthy-brown banners. Curved multi-tiered sandstone and grey-stone spectator galleries wrap around the arena, lit by warm amber wood-fire braziers along the parapet walls. No creatures in the center ring.

assetCards.name: char_dragon_body
assetCards.prompt: 8k dark-fantasy realism, full-body studio reference on a solid light gray background. A fierce, muscular Common wyvern-dragon with weathered bronze-brown and earthy ochre scales, wide leathery bat-like wings with sharp wing-thumb spurs, a long muscular tail, powerful hindlegs planted firmly, and smaller raptorial forelimbs with curved black talons. Angular reptilian skull crowned with swept-back bone brow horns, parted jaws with white fangs, and glowing pupil-less white eyes.

assetCards.name: char_stego_body
assetCards.prompt: 8k dark-fantasy realism, full-body studio reference on a solid light gray background. A heavy, battle-bred Common Stegosaurus dinosaur standing on four massive pillar legs with blunt stone-crushing claws and a thick pebbly moss-green and dark olive hide. A dramatic double row of oversized, jagged bronze-brown diamond dorsal plates rises along its arched spine to a muscular spiked tail, with a rugged beaked head featuring an upward nasal horn and twin brow horns.

assetCards.name: char_wolf_body
assetCards.prompt: 8k dark-fantasy realism, full-body studio reference on a solid light gray background. A lean, heavily muscled Common dire wolf with ash-grey and dark charcoal fur in a low, coiled predatory stance on four scarred legs with razor-clawed paws. A jagged, bristling mane of spiked silver-white and black fur erupts across its neck and shoulders, framing a snarling muzzle with bared ivory fangs and piercing pale-white eyes.

clips.name: clip_01_colosseum_flyover
clips.section: Beat 1 - Floating Colosseum Approach & Bird's-Eye Reveal (0:00-0:06)
clips.stateLock: no creatures in center ring; wood-fire braziers burning
clips.prompt: High aerial establishing shot banking over @set_colosseum_common, no people in frame. The floating camera glides at 25 km/h through night mist before tilting straight down into a bird's-eye view of the circular arena. Warm amber wood-fire braziers cast flickering glow across the flagstones.

clips.name: clip_02_roaring_crowd_dive
clips.section: Beat 2 - Vertical Plunge Into the Roaring Crowd & Rising Beast-Gate (0:06-0:12)
clips.stateLock: no creatures in center ring; central iron portcullis beast-gate rattling upward
clips.prompt: Steep vertical diving shot plunging into @set_colosseum_common, no people in frame. The camera hurtles downward at 40 km/h past tiered stone arches and fluttering banners before skimming low toward the iron portcullis gate as it rattles upward. Rising torchlight sparks scatter across the dusty stone steps.

clips.name: clip_03_dragon_spotlight
clips.section: Beat 3 - Spotlight 1: The Starter Dragon ('Breed the Anatomy!' 0:12-0:18)
clips.stateLock: natural bronze-brown scales; wings snapping open; both hindlegs planted; foreclaws empty
clips.prompt: Low-angle hero shot inside @set_colosseum_common as @char_dragon_body stalks onto the center ring with foreclaws empty. The camera pushes in at 8 km/h while @char_dragon_body plants both hindlegs, snaps its wings wide open, and cranes its neck skyward. Amber brazier firelight rims the outstretched wings.

clips.name: clip_04_stego_spotlight
clips.section: Beat 4 - Spotlight 2: The Starter Stegosaurus ('Raise a Champion!' 0:18-0:26)
clips.stateLock: natural moss-green hide and bronze dorsal plates; all four feet planted on stone
clips.prompt: Wide low-angle tracking shot across @set_colosseum_common as @char_stego_body marches into the stone ring with all four feet planted. The gimbal camera orbits smoothly at 10 km/h while @char_stego_body crushes loose rubble underfoot and swings its heavy tail. Warm torchlight glints sharply along the raised dorsal plates.

clips.name: clip_05_wolf_and_trio_standoff
clips.section: Beat 5 - Spotlight 3: The Starter Dire Wolf & Trio Finale ('The Hall of Legends Claims Its Throne!' 0:26-0:34)
clips.stateLock: wolf in low predatory crouch with front paws braced; dragon and stegosaurus flanking in center ring
clips.prompt: Fast whip-pan across @set_colosseum_common settling on @char_wolf_body lunging into a low crouch with front paws braced. The camera pulls back at 12 km/h to reveal @char_dragon_body, @char_stego_body, and @char_wolf_body standing united in the center ring. Swirling embers and warm brazier shadows sweep across the arena floor.
